unit.label: -ancy / -mancy
unit.core_meaning: a state, action or process — and, in -mancy, divination by some means
unit.mentor_note: The -mancy family is a small museum of how people have tried to read the future. You will almost never need the words themselves; you will often need the habit of reading the first half of a long word to find its subject.

members.meaning: forecasting the future through biblical books
forecasting through the use of dice
forecasting by communication with the dead

predict_options.text: Foretelling the future by some particular means
The scientific study of an object

discovery.understand_note: Mancy is always divination; the piece in front of it names what is being read — books, bones, dice, palms, handwriting. Split the word and the meaning falls out.

applies.prompt: Knowing -mancy means divination, and necro- means death, what is necromancy?
